title: Svetambara-Digambara division
summary: Position 1: Digambara tradition traces the division to the famine-era migration and disputes over practice and the canon's survival. Position 2: Svetambara tradition and most scholars describe a gradual divergence, formalized by about the 5th century CE. The two communities differ on monastic dress, the canon, and women's liberation.
